subject.title: RFC: add local adaptive-refresh replay tooling

question: Should CodexBar upstream own the offline replay products, persistent opt-in runtime trace collection, and Codex/Claude transcript-metadata probe, and what trace lifecycle must be supported?
rationale: Correct code and green tests cannot decide the permanent package surface, local privacy boundary, hidden configuration, or retention and deletion obligations introduced by this RFC.

options.title: Split into staged PRs
options.body: Review a rebased pure replay kit and CLI first, then separately decide runtime recording and the activity probe under a documented lifecycle contract.

options.title: Approve the combined boundary
options.body: Explicitly accept all new products, hidden opt-in configuration, persistent records, transcript metadata access, and manual deletion as one supported diagnostic feature.

options.title: Keep collection out of tree
options.body: Own only offline replay code upstream and leave runtime trace generation and coding-activity collection external.

recommendation.title: Split into staged PRs
recommendation.body: Review a rebased pure replay kit and CLI first, then separately decide runtime recording and the activity probe under a documented lifecycle contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner has the strongest scheduler history and authority to accept the long-term product, privacy, and maintenance obligations.
